claims.text: Clinician note records lip swelling after the first dose of cefalexin, and documents allergy to cefalexin as flagged.

citations.quote: Lip swelling after the first dose of cefalexin. Allergic to cefalexin; documented and flagged.

claims.text: Patient reports no new symptoms across daily check-ins from late July through mid-August 2026, each stating good sleep and nothing new to report.

citations.quote: Daily check-in 60. I slept well and have nothing new to report today.
Daily check-in 22. I slept well and have nothing new to report today.

open_questions: The record contains no medication list entry showing whether any medications were started, stopped, held or changed; only the cefalexin reaction is documented.
The record contains no entry stating the indication or dose of the cefalexin dose that preceded the lip swelling.
The record contains no earlier entries (before 2026-07-11) documenting prior antibiotic use or previous antibiotic reactions.
No follow-ups, referrals or tests are recorded in the available entries.
The record does not say whether the cefalexin allergy was entered before or after the reaction was documented.

citation.quote: Allergic to cefalexin; documented and flagged.

candidate_highlights.risk_reason: Documented allergy to cefalexin following lip swelling after the first dose; the record does not show which medications were given or changed since.
candidate_highlights.suggested_action: Review the allergy entry and confirm the allergen and reaction are recorded consistently before any prescribing decision.
